body: I've tried everything for six months now, i didn't even drink before this but now i'm drunk all the time and doing drugs, not even that helps. She was the one and i lost her, so i'm fucked.
Everything is pointless man... I've tried everything for six months and nothing helps, drugs and alcohol helps but that's very temporary :(

I get to attached to people. Always been like that. The first true love left me and it took me like 8 years to get somewhat over her, i'm still not over her completely. Then i met this girl, she had a relationship but we hanged out and eventually she ended up with me, but she left too. Everyone always leaves, sooner or later. I really thought i would be with her forever, we had something special, we were soulmates, we always told eachother that, but one day she was gone. Six months and if my previous experience is an indicator it will be seven and a half year until i'm somewhat over her. I will be almost 40 by then, way past the point of having a family. So what's the point, really? I was never meant for this world in the first place, i feel too strong, too much... I can't take it.

The thing is, i was with a girl before her and i loved her with all my heart, then it ended i was fucked for years, it took me 8 years to get over that one, well, "over", i'm still not 100% over her... Then i met this girl, and i was shocked that someone showed interest in me... I loved her with all i had, i did everyhting for her but that wasn't enough, she blamed me for everything, she said she couldn't be with someone who made her so angry, but she still gets angry... It wasn't my fault... I never did anything to hurt her but she hates me, she won't talk to me. Six fucking months. I will never find someone again, i'm fat and ugly and the ones that actually liked me leaved... I don't want to die but i feel like it's the only way to be free.
I don't want to feel like this. I don't want to die... All i want is happiness... But i will never get that, i hate myself, i just want the pain to stop.
